title: Rockstar Confirms Ongoing GTA Online Support After GTA 6 Launch
description: Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick confirmed that Rockstar Games will continue supporting GTA Online with new content and events well after GTA 6 launches, alongside massive sales milestones for GTA V and the series.
youtubeTitle: GTA Online Support Confirmed After GTA 6 Release
socialHook: Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick has officially confirmed that GTA Online will continue to receive robust content support and events well after GTA 6 launches.

sections.heading: Take-Two Interactive Financial and Strategy Outlook
paragraphs: According to a report by RockstarINTEL, Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick confirmed during the company's Q2 2027 quarterly earnings presentation that Rockstar Games intends to keep supporting GTA Online well after GTA 6 comes out. Zelnick stated that the game has been highly successful and resilient, continuing to grow over the years. The company's official documents list ongoing support in the form of more content and events, rather than just keeping the servers live. GTA 6 will not launch with a new GTA Online or multiplayer mode, but the existing GTA Online for GTA V will remain a focal point for years to come.

sections.heading: GTA Series Sales and Future Prospects
paragraphs: During the same investor briefing, Take-Two Interactive revealed massive sales figures for the Grand Theft Auto franchise. Grand Theft Auto V has now surpassed 235 million copies sold worldwide, up from 230 million in May, and remains one of the most downloaded PlayStation 5 games monthly. The total sales for the entire Grand Theft Auto series have reached 480 million copies. These figures highlight the immense commercial longevity of Rockstar's flagship franchise as the company prepares for the launch of GTA 6 and its subsequent pre-orders.
